violations.why: closer2_isr can preempt main between its two reads of test_global_var1, so the reads can return different values.
writer2_isr can preempt main between the two reads of test_global_var2, so reader3 and reader4 can differ.
closer2_isr (higher priority) can preempt closer1_isr after it sets tco_expect_close to 42. closer2_isr resets it to 0 at line 376, so the check at line 756 can fail.
closer2_isr can preempt closer1_isr between its write of tco_write_buf and the read inside i8xx_tco_write, and overwrite the buffer.
